name: QC Coverage
description: One row per (child_doctype, child_row_name) that currently has an active QC Inspection. source_row is the DB-enforced uniqueness primitive that answers 'does this row already have coverage' without guessing via item+batch matching. Rows are inserted the moment a QC Inspection is created for a source row, and deleted when that QC Inspection is cancelled/deleted so a fresh inspection can legitimately be created later (e.g. rework after a Fail).

fields.label: Source Row
fields.description: {child_doctype}:{child_row_name} — computed once the row itself has a stable name. This is the actual concurrency-safe uniqueness primitive: the DB rejects a second QC Coverage row for the same source_row, so a duplicate-key error (not a lock) is what stops two simultaneous submits from both creating coverage for the same row.
